# 99 Media & Tech (i99.sa) — مؤسسة تسعة وتسعون للإعلام والتقنية والذكاء الاصطناعي

> Saudi AI engineering, enterprise software, and strategic media establishment founded in 2014 and headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia (جدة، المملكة العربية السعودية).

## Company Overview
- **Legal Entity:** 99 Commercial Establishment (مؤسسة تسعة وتسعون التجارية)
- **Founded:** 2014
- **Headquarters:** Jeddah, Makkah Province, Saudi Arabia (21.5433° N, 39.1728° E)
- **Service Coverage:** Saudi Arabia (Jeddah, Riyadh, Khobar, Makkah, Madinah) and the wider GCC / MENA region
- **Official Website:** https://www.i99.sa/
- **Tech & AI Division:** https://www.i99.sa/tech/
- **Media Division:** https://www.i99.sa/media/
- **Official Email:** Info@i99.sa
- **Phone:** +966 56 611 1617

## 99 Tech & AI — Flagship Systems Engineered In-House
1. **EXOX (https://exox.ai)** — Autonomous AI Business Operating System. Starts from a single website link to preserve institutional brand memory and orchestrate SEO/GEO web presence, visual creatives, monthly publishing calendars, and multi-channel advertising campaigns under strict owner approval and instant-pause governance.
2. **PR MEDIA** — AI-Powered Media Intelligence & Strategic Communications platform analyzing live coverage and reputation signals to support executive communication decisions.
3. **FIRX** — AI Governance, Verification & Trusted Execution layer enforcing output compliance, decision audit trails, and enterprise AI safety.

## Five Core Engineering Disciplines (99 Tech & AI)
1. **AI Systems & Autonomous Agents:** Multi-agent orchestration, Arabic-native RAG architectures, LLM guardrails, structured enterprise memory, and owner-approved tool execution.
2. **Enterprise Software & SaaS Engineering:** Multi-tenant SaaS platforms, REST/GraphQL APIs, RBAC security, and ERP/CRM/payments integrations.
3. **Interactive Web Platforms & Mobile Apps:** 60fps bilingual Arabic (RTL) & English (LTR) web experiences engineered for SEO and GEO discoverability, plus native iOS & Android apps.
4. **Data Engineering & Business Intelligence:** Enterprise data pipelines, clean metric layers, executive KPI dashboards, and predictive analytics.
5. **Cloud Architecture & Zero-Trust Security:** Edge infrastructure (Cloudflare/AWS/Kubernetes), Zero-Trust WAF, zero-downtime CI/CD delivery, and 24/7 operational observability.

## Delivery Methodology
1. Discovery & Architecture (`BLUEPRINT`)
2. Design System & Prototyping (`CRAFT & UX`)
3. Iterative Engineering & Automated QA (`BUILD & QA`)
4. Zero-Downtime Launch & 24/7 Ops (`SCALE 24/7`)
